name: Raymarched soft shadows project directional penumbras with Bayer matrix dithering and key light alignment
description: Validates the Raymarched Soft Shadows engine in the studio inspector, configuring bounded 2.5D directional cast shadows and elliptical contact drop shadows, selecting Obsidian and Indigo color presets, configuring Bayer matrix ordered dithering (2x2 and 4x4), and synchronizing shadow azimuth and elevation with the photometric key light.

planSteps.description: Click the 'PixiBud AI' tab button in the right inspector panel (data-testid tab-ai)
Verify the Raymarched Soft Shadows section is displayed with the 2.5D Ground Projection badge
Click the 'Manual' button in the Raymarched soft shadows mode group
Verify the manual shadow controls appear including Align with Key Light and Dither Filter
Click the 'Ground Drop (Oval)' button in the shadow style controls
Click the 'Directional Cast' button to switch back to directional ground projection
Click the 'Align with Key Light' button to synchronize shadow direction
Click the 'Render Cast Shadow' button to execute the 2.5D shadow render
Verify the studio canvas remains active and updated
